ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'On a grievous day' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the 'Yawm al-Din as the ultimate reckoning where the deceitful will face the consequences of their hidden fraudulence. It highlights the transition from worldly deception to divine truth, serving as a spiritual warning for believers to align their inner intentions with their outward actions.
